sources.snippet: Speculators is a library for training speculative decoding draft models that deploy directly to LLM inference engines like vLLM. Speculative decoding is a lossless technique that speeds up LLM inference by using a smaller, faster draft model (i.e. "the speculator") to propose tokens, which are then verified by the larger base model, reducing latency without compromising output quality.
